# R270 — Exponential one-effect mass obstruction in a positive affine BRC

Date: 2026-10-25. **AUTHOR-SIDE MATHEMATICAL DERIVATION + EXACT INTEGER CERTIFICATE; NOT DRIVER REVIEWED; NOT NATIVE ADMITTED.**

## Source and exact scope

Fixed GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE_V1 main d507a0acee01afd268b5b26d296f34a745df210c; original P000 blob 770e1b157fc10aab7b25d80c2cd52d6fcd07c9dc exactly matches startup projection, status ACTIVE_LOCKED. Fixed Enterprise Math Source main da155518fd74ffd1107228ce60b7aa4f3592e40b. Reuses R268 aac6b9ae60761cceab87c8dbe5d20432b3406d07 (six-channel common-effect base witnesses) and R269 author-side support-band draft 26db7f7082b7bc244e2cbda2e043e577697ed620. Other R269 parity-window work remains separate.

This is a **formal** positive BRC on six formal slots, NOT an established P000-native X6 update, R193 path/time-port, native spatial rotation or physical heartbeat trajectory. Ordered path length n is not physical time. Genuine formal affine effect is g=(epsilon,k), epsilon=±1, k integer, acting as F_g(z1,...,z6)=(epsilon*z1+k,epsilon*z2,z3,z4,z5,z6). Chronological composition is (epsilon,k) THEN (eta,b)=(eta*epsilon,eta*k+b).

Start (q,r,epsilon,k)=(0,0,+1,0). Each selector has positive unit weight. Control transition for selector 0/1 respectively: q=0 -> (2,-1,-1)/(2,+1,-1); q=1 -> (0,-1,-1)/(0,+1,-1); q=2 -> (1,+1,+1)/(2,+1,-1). Provenance monitor r=0 (no 00, last nonzero or start), r=1 (no 00, last zero), r=2 (00 seen). For selector 0/1 respectively, transitions r=0 -> (1,0), r=1 -> (2,0), r=2 -> (2,2).

The six terminal channels in fixed order C=((0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0),(2,1)), where second slot is h=1 iff r=2. H_n(c,g) counts all ordered length-n selector words with exact final channel c and complete effect g. Positive integer path multiplicities and authentic effect labels are retained, not merely Boolean support.

## Lemma R270.1: an exact 16,482-fold 30-step source reset

Let P_n(q,r,e,k) be the exact nonnegative integer state count, with P_0(0,0,+1,0)=1 and recurrence
P_(n+1)(q',delta(r,a),eta*e,eta*k+b) += P_n(q,r,e,k)
for both selectors. Unique last-selector deletion proves this recurrence exhausts every binary word exactly once.

**Exact finite coefficient:** P_30(0,0,+1,-4)=16482. Thus there exist exactly 16,482 different length-30 selector words that ALL return both q and r to (0,0) and carry the same authentic effect (+1,-4).

Verification: the provided Python exact integer recurrence computes all depths 0..160 and checks all 8191 original selector words for lengths 0..12; the separately coded C++17 big-integer recurrence checks depths 0..80 and confirms the 30-step coefficient. Their numerical agreement is an **executed finite certificate**, not a claim of a closed formula for P_n at arbitrary n. As an additional hand-check, the last two steps give P_30(0,0,+1,-4)=P_29(1,1,+1,-3)=P_28(2,0,+1,-4).

The 3-step source reset p=101 returns q=r=0 with effect (+1,-1). From the verified R268 bases, at lengths j=7,8,9, the common effects and exact six-channel vectors are respectively:
j=7: (+1,-3), b7=(2,2,3,1,1,9);
j=8: (+1,0), b8=(1,6,1,9,2,16);
j=9: (-1,-1), b9=(1,19,2,20,4,28).

## Theorem R270.A: exponential positive multiplicity in every depth's common effect fiber

For arbitrary integer n>=7, define K=floor((n-7)/30), t=n-30K, j=7+((t-7) mod 3), h=(t-j)/3. Then 7<=t<=36, j belongs to {7,8,9}, and 0<=h<=9. Set
g_n=(epsilon_j, k_j-epsilon_j*(4K+h)).

**For every one of the six terminal channels c**,
H_n(c,g_n) >= 16482^K b_j(c).                                    (1)

Proof: choose independently any of 16,482 length-30 genuine reset words in each of K fixed-length prefix blocks; append h copies of p=101, then an arbitrary length-j word from base common-effect fiber with channel c. Distinct choices give distinct length-(30K+3h+j)=n selector strings. Every reset restores q=r=0; their combined effect is (+1,-4K-h). Chronological composition with base effect (epsilon_j,k_j) gives g_n. Hence the injection produces exactly 16482^K b_j(c) distinct words in the target fiber, proving (1) for all n. The unbounded claim follows by construction, not finite-depth extrapolation.

## Theorem R270.B: quantitative no-go for fewer than six aggregate control states

Use the full, deliberately broad D(d) comparison class of R268: arbitrary d-control positively rational-weighted BRC with authentic affine effects; arbitrarily many edges and time-dependent packets/weights are allowed. No path-by-path homomorphism is required. Candidate mass mu_n(v,g)>=0 is read through an arbitrary SINGLE-VALUED deterministic terminal decoder D(v,n,g)∈C. The joint candidate histogram is Hhat_n(c,g)=sum_(v:D(v,n,g)=c) mu_n(v,g).

For fixed n,g a given control v decodes to at most one channel; therefore Hhat_n(.,g) can have nonzero support in at most d channels. Define s_(j,t) as sum of the t smallest entries of b_j. For 1<=d<=5 and g=g_n, a positive true channel mass is missing on at least 6-d channels. By (1):
sum_c |H_n(c,g_n)-Hhat_n(c,g_n)| >= 16482^K s_(j,6-d).           (2)

If the candidate ALSO exactly preserves the unmarked full-effect marginal sum_c Hhat_n(c,g_n)=sum_c H_n(c,g_n), all missing channel mass is necessarily compensated as surplus on represented channels, and hence:
sum_c |H_n(c,g_n)-Hhat_n(c,g_n)| >= 2*16482^K s_(j,6-d).         (3)

Sorted base vectors are b7=(1,1,2,2,3,9), b8=(1,1,2,6,9,16), b9=(1,2,4,19,20,28). For d=5 all s_(j,1)=1; (3) gives a one-effect unnormalized L1 lower bound 32964 at n=37, and 543312648 at n=67. The derivation never assumes fixed terminal readout or stationary candidate transitions.

The normalized bound divides (2)/(3) by total original count 2^n and tends to zero at this rate; it must NOT be called a uniform normalized or physical error floor. If the effect marginal is not preserved, the factor-two version (3) cannot be claimed.

## Validation, actual status, next falsifier

Python source R270_exact_amplification.py: exact recurrence n=0..160, raw 8191-word enumeration through n=12, original base vectors, coefficient 16482, all n>=7 sample instances of (1), PASS. Independent C++17 implementation: exact recurrence n=0..80, PASS; stdout and JSON reports accompany this paper. Infinite n proof is separate from the finite checks.

Reusable BRC interfaces: R268's exact path-positive count recurrence and formal affine THEN law are **REUSE_APPLIED**; existing family extended by a quantitative reset coefficient, not renamed as a new BRC family. Native ControlPacket.from_edges/Affine.then/EffectHistogram package was not executed here. P000 and ACTIVE worldview unchanged.

**Unresolved:** the six-versus-seven question in D(d) remains 6<=d_min<=7; this theorem excludes/quantifies d<=5, NOT d=6. Next discriminating task is to test all-depth cross-effect/time transition compatibility for genuinely six-state positive affine representations (or construct one), using R269's exact saturation bands and honest Source-native R193 port rules when available. This author proof/branch is not a live Researcher CLAIM, Result, independent Driver verdict or Foundation admission.
